source: Validated model output saved by PR Briefings for a public PR, in-the-loop-labs/pair-review#219 (head 3158f99). Used as a regression fixture: schema changes must keep accepting known-good output.

pr.title: Consolidate duplicated SVG icons into shared icons.js module
pr.author: tjwp

document.verdict: This PR centralizes all duplicated inline SVGs into a single shared icons.js module and switches consumers to a small window.Icons.icon() helper without changing UI intent.

summary.claim: Introduces a shared SVG icon registry and icon(name, …) helper, then replaces many inline SVGs with window.Icons.icon(...) calls.

evidence.quote: * Shared SVG icon registry and helper.

evidence.note: Icons script is loaded on PR page

summary.claim: Affects multiple UI surfaces including AIPanel, ChatPanel, SuggestionManager, DiffRenderer, PRManager, and modals by swapping inline SVG strings for helper invocations.

evidence.note: ChatPanel header icon uses shared icon
DiffRenderer swaps inline SVG for helper
PRManager references Icons for eye icon

summary.claim: Limits changes to icon rendering strings; controls, titles, and aria-labels continue to be set as before.

evidence.quote: Ask questions about this review, or the changes
evidence.note: UI copy unchanged; only icon markup changed

summary.claim: Test suite is updated to load or stub window.Icons, and unknown icon names return an empty string.

evidence.note: Unit tests load the new module
Behavior for unknown icon key is defined
Helper returns empty string for unknown names

behavior.before: Each component and module embedded duplicated inline SVG strings or per-file constants (e.g., static ICONS in AIPanel) and set innerHTML to those strings.

beforeEvidence.note: Inline constant used at render time
Utility class held inline SVG strings

behavior.after: A new shared module defines an icon registry and a window.Icons.icon(name, …) helper. Pages load icons.js, and components call Icons.icon to render SVGs with optional size/class options.

afterEvidence.note: Icons module loaded on PR page

examples.caption: Renders the same eye icon via the shared helper
Adds the new shared registry to page boot

impacts.name: Shared icons registry (public/js/utils/icons.js)
impacts.change: Adds ICON_DEFS and icon(name, width?, height? | opts) API, exporting window.Icons and supporting stroke/fill variants and size/class overrides.

evidence.quote: * Shared SVG icon registry and helper.

impacts.name: PR and Local pages (public/pr.html, public/local.html)
impacts.change: Ensure the icons.js script is loaded so components can call window.Icons.icon(...) at runtime.

impacts.name: AIPanel component
impacts.change: Replaces inline constants and SVG strings with Icons.icon('eye'|'eyeClosed'|...), reducing duplication.

impacts.name: DiffRenderer module
impacts.change: Drops static SVG constants (chevrons) in favor of Icons.icon('chevronRight'|'chevronDown').

impacts.name: PRManager theme and eye icons
impacts.change: Switches icon getters and theme toggle icons to use Icons.icon('eye'|'eyeClosed'|'sun'|'moon').

impacts.name: Unit tests
impacts.change: Update tests to require icons.js or stub window.Icons so components render during test runs.

flows.title: AIPanel filter toggle updates its eye/eyeClosed icon

steps.label: Check current filter state
steps.detail: Determines showDismissedComments and sets title/aria-label accordingly.

steps.label: Render appropriate icon
steps.detail: Instead of concatenating inline SVG constants, it now calls window.Icons.icon('eye'|'eyeClosed', 14, 14).

steps.label: Apply to button
steps.detail: Sets innerHTML and aria-label on filterToggleBtn.

flows.title: Page boot ensures shared icons are available to consumers

steps.label: Load shared icons module
steps.detail: PR and Local HTML pages include <script src="/js/utils/icons.js"></script> so window.Icons is defined.

steps.label: Initialize components
steps.detail: Downstream JS runs (components, modules) and calls window.Icons.icon(...) during render.

steps.label: Icons render with defaults or overrides
steps.detail: Helper applies default 16x16 or caller-supplied width/height/className.

inScope: Front-end icon rendering strings across components/modules are refactored to call a shared helper.
outOfScope: No API contracts, server behavior, or business logic outside icon rendering are changed.
unchanged: Control semantics, labels, and event handlers (e.g., aria-labels, button titles, click handlers) remain the same.

considerations.title: Script load order must provide window.Icons before consumers run
considerations.detail: If icons.js loads after modules/components execute, window.Icons.icon() calls would fail.
considerations.check: Open public/pr.html and public/local.html to verify icons.js appears before module scripts that render UI.

considerations.title: Stroke-based vs fill-based icons handled via attrs
considerations.detail: Some icons (logo, sparkle) require stroke attributes; the registry includes attrs so they render correctly.
considerations.check: Inspect logo and sparkle renders; ensure stroke color/width apply as expected.

considerations.title: Default dimensions are 16 unless overridden
considerations.detail: Helper defaults to 16x16; most callers pass explicit sizes matching prior UI to avoid layout changes.
considerations.check: Spot-check buttons where size isn't passed to icon(); compare before/after sizes visually.

considerations.title: Typos or missing icon names render nothing
considerations.detail: Unknown icon keys return an empty string, which would remove the icon silently.
considerations.check: Search for window.Icons.icon('...') calls; ensure names match ICON_DEFS; run icons.test.js for safety.

considerations.title: Tests updated to load or stub window.Icons
considerations.detail: New dependency requires either requiring icons.js or stubbing window.Icons in tests.
considerations.check: Run unit tests; verify added requires/stubs; watch for ReferenceError: Icons.
